name: The Orphaned House
summary:
Step into mystery in The Orphaned House. Explore its rooms, manipulate the environment to solve puzzles, and follow your intuition to uncover every hidden secret in this atmospheric adventure game. Curiosity will be rewarded. The truth must be unlocked. Can you solve the mystery of The Orphaned House?

The Orphaned House is brought to you by Charm Games, the award-winning studio behind the groundbreaking worlds of FORM and Twilight Path. Curiosity and smarts are key to unravelling the mysteries within its walls. Be intrepid, dig deep, and witness the cascading impact of your visit as the House responds to your presence and actions. This is a world built for the observant eye. Study each room carefully to solve intuitive puzzles woven into the very structure of this beautiful, intricately designed house.
